description: React component for confirming and downloading a PDF file related to a job, including UI elements and API interactions.

methods.name: DownloadPanel
methods.description: React functional component that provides UI for confirming a job and downloading the resulting PDF.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation of the job by calling the confirmJob API and updating UI messages.

methods.name: onDownload
methods.description: Handles the download process by calling downloadPdf API, creating a download link, and managing UI state.
